independent.summary: Routing FULLTEXT/SPATIAL through looksLikeIndex makes an index whose unquoted name is a TYPE_WORD invent a bogus column: `CREATE TABLE t (body text, FULLTEXT KEY text (body));` fails the isTypeWord test at :372, the shape returns false, the fallback to TABLE_CONSTRAINTS is skipped, and readColumn produces an attribute `FULLTEXT = KEY text (body)` (before the change the definition was merely skipped). Narrow in practice — mysqldump backtick-quotes index names, and the ident token bypasses isTypeWord — but hand-written DDL hits it.
